title: Kraft tardises Resource pack
description: necessary resource pack for the kraft tardises datapack.
body:
a required resource pack for the kraft tardises datapack. Changes no vanilla items but adds  new models and items.

# Additions
- Model for TARDIS exterior
- Sonic Screwdrivers from the second doctor's all the way to the eleventh
- Model for first doctor's TARDIS monitor
- GUI elements for controlling the TARDIS
- model for dalek blaster
- model for copper battery
- model for fezes

# Requirements
[datapack for functionality](https://modrinth.com/project/4hPLDiRu)
